title: iPhone 17 vs iPhone 16: 6 Upgrades Worth Knowing in 2026
text:
iPhone 17 vs iPhone 16: 6 Upgrades Worth Knowing in 2026 iPhone 17 vs iPhone 16: 6 Upgrades Worth Knowing in 2026
 Somatirtha
 iPhone 17 Display: The iPhone 17 features a 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR display with ProMotion up to 120Hz, delivering smoother scrolling than the iPhone 16. 
 iPhone 17 Performance: The iPhone 17 uses Apple's A19 chip, while the iPhone 16 features the A18, bringing a newer generation of processing capabilities. 
 iPhone 17 Front Camera: The iPhone 17 introduces an 18MP Centre Stage front camera, compared with the iPhone 16's 12MP TrueDepth camera for selfies and video calls. 
 iPhone 17 Rear Cameras: The iPhone 17 features a 48MP Dual Fusion camera system, including an upgraded ultrawide camera, while the iPhone 16 also has a 48MP main camera. 
 iPhone 17 Battery Life: Apple rates the iPhone 17 for up to 30 hours of video playback, compared with up to 22 hours on the iPhone 16. 
 iPhone 17 Charging: The iPhone 17 supports faster wired charging, reaching up to 50 per cent in around 20 minutes with a compatible adapter. 
  iPhone 17 Storage: The iPhone 17 starts with 256GB of storage, doubling the iPhone 16's 128GB base option and giving users more room for apps and photos. 
 iPhone 17 Connectivity: The iPhone 17 supports Apple's newer wireless networking hardware, including Wi-Fi 7, while the iPhone 16 supports Wi-Fi 7 through its connectivity specifications. 
 iPhone 17 Design: The iPhone 17 retains an aluminium frame and Ceramic Shield front protection, while its display improvements make everyday viewing more fluid and responsive.
